s: a riverside café-bar tucked beneath the Tanzhaus, right on the Limmat
w: A ground-floor café-bar built into the new Tanzhaus Zürich building, its terrace running straight down to the Limmat between the water and Wipkingen's quieter bank. Easy to miss unless you already know it's there -- an unassuming entrance opening onto one of the calmer riverside spots away from the main Niederdorf crowds.
_facts: Located at Wasserwerkstrasse 127a, 8037 Zürich, Wipkingen, entrance via Kloster-Fahr-Weg
Housed on the ground floor of the Tanzhaus Zürich building
Large terrace directly on the Limmat river

s: a multi-roaster café and co-working space in a former factory courtyard by the Limmat
w: A specialty coffee café built into the courtyard of a former factory on Sihlquai, part of a nearly 1,700-square-metre co-working and community complex spread across four floors. The terrace and ground-floor café sit a short walk from Zurich HB and next to Oberer Letten, the Limmat's most popular river-bathing spot.
_facts: Set in the courtyard of a former factory building, part of the Impact Hub Zürich Colab complex
Combines a specialty coffee café with co-working, meeting and workshop spaces
Near Oberer Letten, a well-known Limmat river bathing spot

s: a café and event hall inside a decommissioned Selnau power station
w: A former electricity substation (Unterwerk Selnau) turned café, restaurant and event space, with 22 stacked shipping containers dividing the high-ceilinged hall into a concert area and a café-restaurant zone. The sun-facing terrace runs right along the Limmat, a short walk from Zurich HB but a world away from the station's polish.
_facts: Located at Selnaustrasse 25, 8001 Zürich, in the former Unterwerk Selnau substation building
22 stacked shipping containers divide the hall into an event space and the Kraftwerk Café & Restaurant
Terrace directly on the Limmat river
Within walking distance of Zurich Hauptbahnhof

s: a design-forward specialty roaster with a hidden upstairs matcha gallery
w: A specialty coffee roaster on Josefstrasse built around careful, considered design -- calm interiors, precise brewing, and (in some of its spaces) a quieter Japanese-influenced matcha counter tucked upstairs. Part of a small, deliberately unshowy chain that treats every detail, from the cup to the room, as worth getting right.
_facts: Flagship café located at Josefstrasse 160, 8005 Zürich, Industriequartier
Specialty coffee roaster and retailer with several café locations across Zurich
Known for design-forward interiors and, at some locations, a Japanese-style matcha offering
